biography: Jan Pokos, a name synonymous with raw talent and a touch of Croatian flair, hails from the coastal town of Split. His journey began not on asphalt, but on the shimmering Adriatic Sea, where he honed his reflexes piloting small boats. At the age of 16, a chance encounter with a local karting club ignited his passion for racing. He traded the sea for the track, quickly mastering the unforgiving Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Shifter category. Jan's aggressive style and fearless overtaking maneuvers earned him a reputation as a rising star. A defining moment came at the Croatian National Karting Championship in 2018, where he clinched victory with a last-lap overtake that left the crowd breathless. Now at 32, Jan is considered to be at his peak, actively seeking opportunities to move into formula racing, using his Karting experience as the foundation to build a career.
drivingStyle: Pokos is an aggressive, late-braking driver known for his daring overtakes and relentless pursuit of the lead. He isn't afraid to push the limits of his equipment, often flirting with the edge of control. While this approach yields spectacular results, it also makes him prone to mistakes. He excels in wet conditions, where his car control and adaptability shine, but struggles slightly with tire management, sometimes sacrificing long-term pace for short bursts of speed.

rivalries.reason: A veteran kart racer known for his tactical approach, Veselic and Pokos have clashed repeatedly. Their contrasting styles often result in intense battles, with Veselic's calculated maneuvers testing Pokos's impulsive aggression.

A fierce competitor known for her unwavering determination, Kovačić has been a constant thorn in Pokos's side. Their on-track battles are legendary, often involving wheel-to-wheel racing and dramatic near-misses.
Rossi's calm and collected demeanor is the polar opposite of Pokos's flashy style. Their rivalry is based on respect, but also on the fundamental difference in their approaches to racing strategy.

famousQuote: "In racing, as in life, you have to risk it all to win it all. Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the Croatian National Karting Championship in 2018 with a breathtaking last-lap overtake, solidifying his reputation as a top karting talent.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the European Karting Championship final in 2020 while leading, costing him a potential title and damaging his confidence.
